key_insight: Bidding controls both advertising outcomes and access to price information, creating a trade-off between campaign performance, margins, budget use and learning.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a basis for budget-aware bidding systems that account for market prices being observed only after successful bids.
method: Model bidding as continuous-time stochastic control with a latent price process.
Estimate prices using parallel exploratory subcampaigns with bounded randomized bids.
Compute policies via forward-equation calibration, HJB policy iteration and a physics-informed neural network, or observable-information entropy-regularized actor-critic learning.
evidence_signal: Synthetic experiments illustrate the estimator and computational procedures; under a stylized sampling model, the estimator is consistent with mean-square error of order N⁻¹.
watch_item: Estimated-price policies and full-information benchmarks do not resolve the genuinely partially observed control problem, and real-world performance remains unvalidated in the abstract.
paper_title: Media Trading with Censored Auction Prices: A Stochastic Control and Reinforcement Learning Approach
